question: Town J is to the north of Town K. Town K is to the east of Town L. Town L is to the west of Town M. Town M is to the south of Town N. Town J is to the south-west of Town N. What is the position of Town K with respect to Town M?
solution:
Given:

Town J is to the north of Town K. Town K is to the east of Town L.

Town L is to the west of Town M. Town M is to the south of Town N.

Town J is to the south-west of Town N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c91c8fca4a300d101724fb212fab17ca77c233f2c41b9aa469e6cfc948c5760a.png] 

Thus, West is the position of town K with respect to Town M.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
